name: Crossing Pair
description: Two independently moving targets cross the arena.

name: Random Dash
description: Appears randomly, moves in a random direction, disappears, and repeats.

name: Random Pop-up
description: Appears for 3 seconds, hides for 1–3 seconds, then appears elsewhere for 4 seconds.

name: Zigzag Sweep
description: A continuous side-to-side sweep down the arena.
